description: 公共施設一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] (series on Tokyo Open Data Catalog) is a series of datasets listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tokyo Metropolitan Government (Open Data Catalog Site). 【町田市】本データは「町田市わたしの便利帳」をもとに、内閣官房情報通信技術(IT)総合戦略室が公開している標準データセットの様式に準じて作成しています。. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal lists 30 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 29 publishers. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
